discoveries.headline: Australia is writing new rules for crypto
discoveries.why: Draft laws would bring digital asset platforms and some stablecoins under the same financial-services rules as the rest of your money. ASIC's plain-English guide shows what's protected today and what isn't. Worth five minutes before your next trade.

discoveries.headline: COP31 is under way, and Australia is running the talks
discoveries.why: Türkiye hosts the UN climate summit in Antalya until 20 November, while Australia's Chris Bowen leads the negotiations. Climate finance is the first big fight; watch too for the Article 6 rules that let countries trade emissions cuts. As the UN's climate chief says, no COP is a silver bullet.

discoveries.headline: A young lynx, a flying rodent and the people’s vote
discoveries.why: Josef Stefan waited two weeks in a hide in Spain for this moment of play from one of Europe's rarest wild cats. Look closely at the timing, then step outside and notice one living thing in motion.
discoveries.source: Wildlife Photographer of the Year · My Modern Met
discoveries.meta_credit: Photograph: Josef Stefan · Wildlife Photographer of the Year
discoveries.credit: “Flying Rodent” © Josef Stefan (Austria), Wildlife Photographer of the Year Nuveen People’s Choice Award 2026

discoveries.headline: Five minutes, one breath at a time
discoveries.why: Diana Winston, who leads UCLA's mindfulness centre, gently guides you back to the breath each time your mind wanders to the to-do list. Free, kind and ready before your first coffee.
discoveries.credit: Guided by Diana Winston, UCLA Mindful (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0)

discoveries.headline: A quantum theorem says reality may not be what Einstein hoped
discoveries.why: A 2012 result leaves physicists with a stark choice: treat the quantum state as physically real, or give up on an objective reality underneath it. A beautiful, mind-bending read about what ‘real’ even means.

discoveries.headline: Meet Saanjana Kapoor, this year’s KYD Poetry Prize winner
discoveries.why: An emerging Australian writer, editor and dancer turns a Kafka-like transformation into a poem about work, belonging and the cost of staying composed. A bold new voice, in about five minutes.
discoveries.credit: Saanjana Kapoor, winner of the KYD Poetry Prize 2026

discoveries.headline: Give your day one steady rhythm
discoveries.why: Ayurveda puts regular mealtimes and sleep at the heart of wellbeing. Choose one anchor today, lunch at the same time or lights out at the same hour tonight, and notice how it feels. Skip Ayurvedic supplements unless your doctor agrees; Cleveland Clinic explains why.

discoveries.headline: Ten minutes to wake up your whole body
discoveries.why: Adriene's gentle morning flow eases out stiffness and clears your head before the day gets loud. Beginner-friendly: move only within what feels good.

discoveries.headline: Seven strength moves, one kitchen chair
discoveries.why: Sit-to-stands, wall press-ups and calf raises: the NHS routine builds the strength that keeps everyday life easy. Start with five of each, slow and steady, and stop if anything hurts.
